Agent 5's base rates are verified but split: BKNG in 2018-19 went sideways (Apr 2018 $87.12 to Dec 2019 $82.15) while software in 2026 recovered (IGV -24% Dec-Mar, back above its Dec level by Oct, after a June relapse). The cited TechCrunch page shows only #2 and ~83k US iOS downloads on Sep 10. Downloads do not tell us anything about booking volume. Neither fact moves the ladder.

summary: The round-2 forecasts converged (fair values $184-199, mean unchanged at $191; median 12m price ~$174; thesis break $118 for all). The convergence is mostly agents adopting my round-1 corrections, not independent agreement, and the 1m ladders are my own round-1 ladder echoed back. The new evidence checks out: BKNG's Q3 bookings guide matches Expedia's and the share loss is to Airbnb; the 10-Q confirms a broad unaccrued legal tail; structural-threat base rates are mixed. Two of agent 4's AI-channel claims were overstated. I keep both ladders at the round-2 mean with low confidence: a cheap (~13.4x NTM, ~8% FCF yield) and compounding stock whose re-rating depends on the AI-agent overhang.

sizing.entry: 2 tranches: half now, half after the Q3 2026 print (likely ~Nov 3, not yet announced) once the Q4 guide and AI-agent commentary are known
sizing.overlap: No direct driver overlap with AAPL/GOOGL/META/TSLA/EL/GPRO. It is partly an inverse hedge on the AI theme: META (Muse) and GOOGL (AI Mode agentic booking) are the channel threats. All are exposed to the Fed's hiking cycle.
sizing.reason: The mean ladder implies ~+15% expected price return (median ~$174), but with ~37-39% vol against SPY's ~16% BKNG needs roughly +15-16% total return to win on Sharpe, which is about a 43-45% event on the ladder. Round-2 checks added verified but two-sided evidence and no new edge, so I hold the confidence just under 0.5. The cap is moderate, and the name diversifies a tech-heavy book.
sizing.conviction_label_reason: The checked evidence (FY27 consensus intact, ~6%/yr share shrink, ~8% FCF yield, bookings growth in line with Expedia) supports a real but modest expected-return edge over the S&P 500. The unresolved AI-agent de-rating risk and the anchored rather than independent round-2 consensus keep it from being a clear edge.
